title: Calabi–Yau Projection Lab
description: Zero-dependency educational laboratory for projecting, slicing and visually encoding higher-dimensional geometric objects onto 2D planes. Includes deterministic orthogonal projections, toy manifolds, Clifford torus, Fermat Calabi-Yau-like patches, exact Fermat topology, a local affine chart of the quintic Calabi-Yau threefold in R^8 with five complex fifth-root branches, reproducible SVG/JSON outputs, a static quintic branch gallery, an interactive web demo, and approximate Fubini-Study induced metric diagnostics. This repository does not compute Ricci-flat Calabi-Yau metrics, does not solve the complex Monge-Ampere equation, and does not simulate string theory physics.
